memory-projection-addendum.json.phase: Optimized compilation of the large existing uor-r4-core library
memory-projection-addendum.json.reason: Release compilation exceeded the original 2 GiB projection. This is disclosed as an observed overrun, not rewritten as prospective compliance. Reserve up to 4 GiB for subsequent compile/test work on the 16 GiB machine. Model evaluation/training keeps the 2 GiB limit.
memory-projection-addendum.json.authorization: Standing local resource-allowance authorization; no paid compute or unique-data deletion.

warm-replication-plan.json.declared_after: Initial exact warm starts: constant schedule 6.30038 with 2/3 held-out grounding; decaying schedule 6.27371 with 3/3, both train36/36 and class4/4.
warm-replication-plan.json.replication: Repeat seed20260923 in a fresh process to verify both exact artifact hashes. Separately run seed20260924, changing only the Fisher-Yates fit-window order; initialization, doses and both learning-rate schedules remain fixed.
warm-replication-plan.json.dose: 128 updates per schedule, four prose windows plus two grounded examples per update; 4.0 grounded weight; fresh optimizer moments and exact exported-weight initialization.
warm-replication-plan.json.report: Every arm, not just the strongest. Saved artifacts, per-document native-scored NLL, head/tail, temporal32, class4, held-out3, crossed-feedback controls and raw generations. Keep lost-grounding outcomes visible.
warm-replication-plan.json.inference: This tests an executable fresh-optimizer warm recipe. It does not separately identify reset, latent-master re-anchoring, extra data exposure or training-objective effects.
warm-replication-plan.json.data: Existing development is exposed. No source-disjoint test text is consulted for this decision.
warm-replication-plan.json.resource: Four additional bounded fits within existing session wall/storage allowance, sequential model work, no paid compute.

freeze-fresh-evaluation.json.freeze_scope: Before downloading or inspecting any new source text
freeze-fresh-evaluation.json.primary_integer_readout: Full-Tune-selected marginal-relative correction, selection ratio-adjudication-1/selection.json, alpha28/32 gamma8/32; use only if same-population count interpolation remains (0.7,0.4). If interpolation changes, refit coefficients on the same predeclared Tune population before opening sources.
freeze-fresh-evaluation.json.warm_selection: The predeclared decaying learning-rate recipe retained all grounded gates at both shuffle seeds. Retain the first seed's artifact, not the best source-evaluation result.
freeze-fresh-evaluation.json.count_comparator: Full-Tune-selected count exponent; no source-based recalibration
freeze-fresh-evaluation.json.sources: Four Project Gutenberg classical prose source families specified in fresh-sources-plan.json; exact external files retained with license and hashes, not committed as model training data.
freeze-fresh-evaluation.json.promotion: No product release or geometric-advantage qualification. Report all source-family outcomes, head/tail and raw generations, including failures.

projection.json.scope: Reconcile all five workstreams, sparse integer local prior/correction, matched full-tune controls, transported depth tests, warm-start schedules with grounded preservation, fresh-source generation and Hamilton-vector operator tests. Commit and protected delivery; archive unique work before reclaiming duplicate worktrees/caches.

likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.declared_after: Primary 114364-target full-Tune adjudication: aggregate gain -0.05252 bits, rare-tail harm +0.65741 bits. No fresh-source text has been loaded.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.hypothesis: The local count prior already includes the Fit marginal. Multiplying it by the entire learned distribution may count marginal frequency twice. Test a learned correction relative to the same Fit-only unigram, without claiming conditional independence.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.candidate: Normalize C^alpha * (A/U)^gamma over Generate, then restore the unchanged native Generate/Copy/Stop group mass.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.parameter_grid: Same alpha numerators [28,30,32,34,36,38,40]/32 and gamma [0..8]/32 for every input; full 2048-window Tune selection only.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.report: Overall and head/tail losses, paired document intervals, boundary optima and same-information controls. First measurement is offline; integer implementation requires its own parity tests.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.data_policy: Exploratory follow-up on exposed development; final source-disjoint corpus stays unopened until final design and coefficients are frozen.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.promotion: No promotion based on aggregate gain that conceals rare-token harm or grounded regression.
likelihood-ratio-followup-plan.json.resource_scope: Within the existing 2-hour session projection, one two-thread model run at a time, no paid compute.

fresh-sources-plan.json.selection_rule: Load no source text until the full-Tune coefficient selection and candidate.prc are written and hash-bound. Do not change coefficients after reading this evaluation.
fresh-sources-plan.json.selection: 16 evenly spaced 64-token windows per source, first eight tokens observed; use pinned derived 4096-token tokenizer and no fresh fitting.
fresh-sources-plan.json.comparison: Frozen native baseline, full-Tune-selected integer residual, full-Tune-calibrated count-only. Include head/rare-tail and actual 48-token continuations, not just teacher forcing.
fresh-sources-plan.json.licensing: Retain Project Gutenberg headers and license with downloaded source; verify published status before downloading. Do not commit complete book text to GitHub.
fresh-sources-plan.json.scope: A small source-family-disjoint classical-prose evaluation, not a general-language benchmark or unseen-pretraining claim.
fresh-sources-plan.json.promotion: None automatic. Accuracy, free generation and grounded retention are separate acceptance dimensions. Preserve negative results.
